zirnox.tick_order: Redstone true latches isOn=true. Load fluid containers; while on, process slots 0..23 in order. Each rod decays once per neighboring NON-breeding rod plus once for itself if not breeding. Each step adds enum heat and life; life>maxLife replaces rod and stops that slot. Earlier replacements can affect later neighbor checks.
zirnox.steam: When 0<heat<maxHeat and water>0 and CO2>0 and steam not full: if heat>10256, cycle=int(((float(heat)-10256F)/100000F)*min(float(co2Fill)/14000F,1F)*25F*7.5F); subtract cycle water (clamp to zero), add cycle superhotsteam (clamp tank), heat -= int(float(heat)*float(pressure)/1000000F). Source does not cap cycle to water remaining or steam free space. Otherwise eligible heat drops by 10.
zirnox.failure: After cooling, pressure>maxPressure OR heat>maxHeat triggers meltdown; equality does not. Destroyed reactor, debris/radiation/explosion require native logic.
zirnox.special_case: While on, meteorite_sword_bred becomes meteorite_sword_irradiated; unrelated item content is not synthesized here.
zirnox.ports: Four oriented ports at lateral +/-2 and heights +1/+3; water/CO2 receive, superhotsteam sends; no HE generation in this reactor.

pile.rod_reaction: outFlux=source + squirt(inFlux)*reactionMultiplier when multiplier>0; squirt(x)=sqrt(x+1/((x+2)*(x+2)))-1/(x+2). Fuel with life<=0 remains unchanged. Otherwise add outgoing flux to depletion; keep with NBT if total<life, else replace with one turnsInto rod without prior NBT.
pile.channel_heat: For each rod: outFlux=getReactivity(stack,incomingNeutrons/channel.length); channel heat += outFlux*rod.heatMult; react consumes outFlux (not incoming flux). Flux propagates through neighboring segments/control multipliers.

ventilation.cooling: For each fueled channel within vertical distance<=1: heat *= (1 - (air/1000)*0.05). Then consume ceil((air/1000)*5) mB from ventilation channel. Vent fills its channel from own tank.

pile.passive_cooling: Each fuel channel heat*=0.999, clamped to minimum20; highestHeat>800 triggers failure.
pile.structure: Hand drill on brick creates current pile core/dummies/edges, height/width5..15; depth probes1..MAX_H_SIZE inclusive and records depth+1 (can reach16), core not on an edge. Drill channels without crossing core/edges/other channels; device and channel orientation/links persist in native data.
pile.interaction: Loader, vent and control are three source item metas 0/1/2 but block metas 0/4/8 plus orientation. Loader/rod insertion, control extraction and ventilation have direct interactions; no fabricated crafter/GUI.

runtime_gaps: Native fuel state/radiation interpolation, source multiblock assembly/conversion/drop behavior, ports, interaction, thermodynamics, failure and faithful models are separate work; stateful content remains Inert.
